worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.summary: Compress pure rage into a crimson dragon shell and fire it straight along the aim: the blow is never compared against attack or defence, so it always tears away a fixed 40 HP no matter how tough the target is (only a type immunity stops it), settling on the first foe it meets and shoving it back. The swift form flies harder but reaches less far.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.use.0: Use fixed damage against a high-defence target
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.use.1: Fire free and straight; the first foe in the path takes the fixed 40
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.use.2: Swift form: speed up to land before the target can walk away
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.description: Whatever the target's defence and typing, a hit always removes %1$s HP; only a type immunity stops it.
The rage reaches %1$s blocks and flies at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s-block hit radius; it settles on the first foe it strikes and shoves it along the aim.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.swift.on: Swift form: flight speed rises to about %2$s blocks per tick and range drops to about %1$s blocks — harder to walk away from during the wind-up, at the cost of a shorter reach.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.swift.off: Standard form: balanced range and speed; it settles on the first foe it meets and shoves it back.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.growth.0: From level %1$s the range rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.growth.1: From level %1$s the range rises to %2$s blocks.
On: the shell flies harder (about x1.25) but the range is cut (about x0.85), so it is harder to walk away during the wind-up at the cost of a shorter reach. Off (standard form, default): balanced range and speed.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of firing. Larger values open from further away.

On: rank by the payoff of this blow - higher target defence first (the fixed 40 ignores defence) and lower remaining health first; very thick health pools are scored down. Off: only the threat itself counts.
